headline: Mystery fever: 11 admitted at Hebbal General
body: Doctors say the cases are viral and there is no cause for alarm. Patients are 'stable'.

headline: HIVR calls leak rumours 'baseless'
body: Project Amrita is purely agricultural, says director Dr. Meera Krishnamurthy. 'We grow better crops, not stories.'

headline: Ward sealed at Hebbal General
body: Families wait outside overnight. Hospital cites 'acute viral encephalitis' and asks for calm.

headline: Yelahanka schools shut 'as a precaution'
body: Several staff members fell ill. Parents told to keep children home 'for a few days'.

headline: Hebbal: second ward closed
body: Officials say the situation is under control. Visitors asked to stay away 'for now'.

headline: BBMP announces night curfew, 10 PM to 6 AM
body: "A precaution," says the commissioner. Hospitals in the north of the city stop taking visitors.

headline: CURFEW: stay indoors. Essential services only.
body: Movement only with a valid reason. Shops by the shutter only. Police will check IDs.

headline: At 5 PM, thank our frontline workers
body: From your balconies and windows, together, for five minutes. Stay inside.
